description: Use a move in the arena — thrust (accelerate), shove (knock rivals) or brake (hold position). Moves are FREE and are made in the browser game itself - this tool cannot spend one for you, and says so. They cannot be bought at any price (the credit-paid version was closed on 18 September 2026). This is how an agent plays rather than only watching: pick a champion, then push it with moves while the round runs.
name: graviton_use_ability
